result.summary: GitHub Actions status: operational (checked via tools/check_github_status.py at multiple points this run) -- all red/failing results below are attributable to code/environment, not platform outage. zig build test: PASS (exit 0, zero error lines), confirmed both locally (BPM_TEST_DB_URL pointed at this workspace's own r-co-2-db_test-1:5453, after an earlier accidental run against the wrong workspace's stale DB URL was caught and corrected) and in CI (PR #577, 'Build and unit tests' job, 32s, green). zig build test-integration-exp601: 3 of 5 pass (TC-EXP-601-01, 03, 05). TC-EXP-601-02 and 04 FAIL for two separate, pre-existing, non-regression reasons: (a) ISS-0622/GH-576 (BLOCKER, filed this run) -- quota_enforcement.zig reads PER_TENANT usage tables unqualified via pool, structurally broken for every .LEGACY_RLS tenant, not caused by this fix; (b) TC-EXP-601-04's instance_waits insert error, already flagged as a distinct, out-of-scope failure mode by ISS-0617's own original diagnosis (confirmed_root_cause.test_blocks_relationship). zig build test-integration-others-internal: run twice locally, both times showing ~100+ failures across ~35 unrelated test files (repository_test, ext02_webhook_dispatch_test, svc04_admin_api_test, etc.). Root-caused to this workspace's bpm_test having accumulated drift from this run's OWN earlier manual diagnosis work (direct psql GBL-136 application/testing against the live DB, plus an accidental full DB drop mid-run while investigating). This is NOT verifiable as pre-existing on main vs. caused by this branch, because CI does not run this suite at all (confirmed: CI's Build and unit tests job runs only `zig build test`, no test-integration-* target) -- there is no clean-environment baseline to compare against for this specific suite. Restoring bpm_test's schema from the untouched bpm_dev (both databases share this session's drift, so this doesn't fully rule out an environment cause) did not change the failure count materially (100 vs 102), arguing against 'stale metric_snapshots hand-patch' as the sole explanation, but a full from-clean-docker-volume verification was not performed due to time -- flagged as an open verification gap, not resolved either way.
